description: Get one AI-visibility audit in detail by scanId (from list_audits): overall AI-citation score + SEO/GEO/authority scores, per-engine citation summary (ChatGPT/Perplexity/Gemini/Claude/Grok/Google AI Overviews/Google AI Mode), the query×engine citation matrix, competitors cited, the top prioritised gaps (title, category, impact, effort), and the SEO and GEO audit checks, each counted pass/warn/fail by its verdict across every page the audit read, as the app counts them. `to_fix` lists the failing and warning checks, the app's "N to fix", with `pages_examined` and `pages_passing` when the check was graded page by page and `homepage_status` when the homepage's own result differs; `advisories` are cross-page findings, reported but never scored or counted; `audit_coverage` gives the pages read, the pages the site lists, and `plan_allowance`, the pages the plan reads beyond the homepage. Per engine: `total` is runs attempted, `answered` is runs that came back with an answer, `unavailable` is runs the engine gave no answer on this time (not counted against the brand; checked again automatically), `pending` is answers still being collected, and `citation_rate` is cited / answered (null when nothing answered). Judge an engine on cited/answered, never cited/total. In the citation matrix every engine appears explicitly per query with one of three states: "cited" (the engine's answer cited the brand), "not_cited" (the engine answered but did not cite the brand), or "not_run" (no measured answer for that query: the engine sat it out, was unavailable this time, or is still collecting; NOT a miss). Bulky raw fields (page HTML, full engine answers) are omitted. Requires a signed-in account.
name: get_audit
